title: money-review report
description: Result of one review: confirmed findings and the candidates the verifier dropped.

rejected.description: Candidates dropped by the verifier. Kept for the eval and for debugging false positives.

rule.description: Checklist rule id, for example RACE-1.

severity.description: high: money is lost or duplicated in a realistic case. medium: needs an unusual timing or a second bug. low: makes a future bug likely or hides one.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root, as in the diff.

line.description: Line in the new version of the file, inside a changed hunk when possible.

title.description: One line, what is wrong. No more than 100 characters.

scenario.description: The order of events that loses or duplicates money, with concrete actors and values.

fix.description: What to change, short. A code snippet is allowed.

reason.description: Why the scenario cannot happen, pointing at the code that prevents it.
